tasks.title: tokenStore.ts: cookie read/write/clear, FR-1 single-flight refresh, FR-5 failure signal
tasks.notes: Unaffected by the vending->proxy reversal (tokenStore is server-only either way; only WHO imports it changed, not its own contract). Exports: writeSession(tokens): Promise<void> (DECISIONS.md D-01); readSession(): Promise<StoredSession|null>; clearSession(): Promise<void>; ensureTokenValid(): Promise<StoredSession> (FR-1 single-flight, per-process refreshPromise, D-07; throws SessionExpiredError on non-2xx refresh after clearing the cookie); getValidAccessToken(): Promise<string> (60s-skew proactive check, AC-6); callWithAuth<T>(makeRequest: (accessToken: string) => Promise<T>, isUnauthorized: (result: T) => boolean): Promise<T> (D-03/AC-7 reactive-401 retry-once -- now consumed by THREE server-side call sites: page.tsx (T-15) and both proxy routes (T-10, T-12), up from the two the vending design had). Never logs a token value anywhere (NFR-security). Module docstring documents the single-flight guard (FR-1) and the refresh-failure chain (FR-5).

tasks.title: GET /login Route Handler: relay to FastAPI, redirect browser to Keycloak
tasks.notes: Unaffected by the vending->proxy reversal -- the login handshake has nothing to do with post-login client-side call authorization. No tokenStore import. Calls FastAPI GET /auth/login server-to-server via fetch(`${getApiBaseUrl()}/auth/login`, {redirect:'manual', signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000)}); reads the Location header and returns NextResponse.redirect(keycloakUrl). A missing Location header or non-3xx/non-501 FastAPI response returns a generic frontend error, no raw FastAPI body surfaced.

tasks.title: GET /callback Route Handler: relay code/state, write session cookie, redirect onward
tasks.notes: Unaffected by the vending->proxy reversal -- the callback exchange writes the cookie regardless of how later client-side calls attach it. Imports tokenStore.writeSession/clearSession (T-02). Reads code/state/error query params; calls FastAPI GET /auth/callback server-to-server (5s timeout). On 200: writeSession(...), redirect to '/' (D-04). On any non-200: no cookie write, redirect to '/login' -- no raw error surfaced.

tasks.title: Retrofit programDetailApi.ts (server module) + move ProgramDetailResult into types/programDetail.ts
tasks.notes: Renumbered from the vending plan's T-11; scope grew to include the type move (DECISIONS.md D-08). FetchProgramDetailOptions gains accessToken?: string alongside switchedFrom?: string. fetchPrograms(opts?: {accessToken?: string}) gains the same parameter (previously took none). Both attach Authorization: Bearer <opts.accessToken> only when present. ProgramDetailResult moves to types/programDetail.ts (F-21) as a shared discriminated union {status:'ok'|'not_found'|'error'|'unauthorized'} -- 'unauthorized' now means 'the caller (a proxy route or page.tsx) already ran callWithAuth's retry-once and still got rejected', not a signal for the CLIENT to retry (D-10). This module is imported by page.tsx (T-15) and, internally, by both proxy routes (T-10, T-12) -- NEVER by ProgramDetailView.tsx or programDetailApi.client.ts (D-08's coupling boundary). Remove both '// D-08: no Authorization header' comments (Documentation requirements).

tasks.title: GET /api/proxy/programs Route Handler: full server-to-server proxy
tasks.notes: ADR-0008/DECISIONS.md D-09/D-10 -- replaces the superseded vending design's GET /api/session/token. Imports tokenStore.callWithAuth/getValidAccessToken (T-02) and the server-side fetchPrograms (F-13, T-05). Body: tokenStore.callWithAuth(token => fetchPrograms({accessToken: token}), () => false /* fetchPrograms degrades to [] on any failure incl. 401, never signals unauthorized -- see T-16's notes on why this stays non-blocking */) then returns NextResponse.json(programs) 200. On a SessionExpiredError from callWithAuth (refresh itself failed): returns NextResponse.json({error:'session_expired'}, {status:401}). No token ever crosses into the response body or a header the browser can read besides the final programs list.

tasks.title: GET /api/proxy/program-detail/[program_id] Route Handler: full server-to-server proxy
tasks.notes: ADR-0008/DECISIONS.md D-09/D-10. Imports tokenStore.callWithAuth (T-02) and the server-side fetchProgramDetail (F-13, T-05). Reads X-Program-Switch-From off the incoming (same-origin, no-CORS) request and forwards it verbatim into fetchProgramDetail's opts.switchedFrom. Body: tokenStore.callWithAuth(token => fetchProgramDetail(params.program_id, {switchedFrom, accessToken: token}), r => r.status === 'unauthorized') then maps the ProgramDetailResult to a response: 'ok' -> 200 body; 'not_found' -> 404; 'unauthorized' (retry-once already exhausted, or callWithAuth threw SessionExpiredError) -> 401 {error:'session_expired'}; 'error' -> 502. This is the one place X-Program-Switch-From still travels anywhere in this story's code -- server-to-server only, never subject to CORS (DECISIONS.md D-11).

tasks.notes: Simplified relative to the superseded vending design: no /api/session/token call, no client-side retry-once dance (the proxy already ran callWithAuth's retry-once server-side before ever responding -- D-10). Imports programDetailApi.client (T-14, compile edge) instead of programDetailApi -- NOT tokenStore, NOT next/headers (client component boundary). T-10/T-12 edges are functional/testing-order, not compile edges (fetch-by-URL, not import) -- same PGD-01-lesson pattern as the superseded plan's T-13<-T-05 edge, kept here in the new shape. Mount's fetchPrograms() call: on any failure (incl. an implicit 401 handled by the proxy returning []-worthy content -- see T-14, fetchPrograms never signals 'unauthorized') stays exactly PGD-01's existing degraded-switcher behavior, unchanged. Switcher's fetchProgramDetail(newId, {switchedFrom}) call: on a {status:'unauthorized'} result, sets window.location.href = '/login' (the client-side manifestation of AC-8/FR-5's redirect chain -- a full browser navigation, distinct from page.tsx's server HTTP redirect in T-15, same eventual outcome). No raw token, cookie, or session concept is ever referenced in this file.

tasks.title: TC-02 integration test: OAuth handshake relay + dual-path bearer forwarding + dev-bypass
tasks.notes: Native vitest mocks only (D-09, no MSW). Retargeted from the superseded vending design. Step 1: invoke login/route.ts's GET() directly, assert redirect to a mocked Keycloak URL. Step 2: invoke callback/route.ts's GET() with test code/state, assert the session cookie is written and the response redirects to '/'. Step 3: mint a token via a mocked POST /auth/dev-bypass, store it through the same writeSession() path T-02/T-04 use. Step 4: directly invoke page.tsx's exported async Page({params}) with the dev-bypass cookie present (mocked next/headers cookies()); assert the resulting fetchProgramDetail call (mocked programDetailApi, F-13) carries Authorization: Bearer <DEV_BYPASS_JWT> sourced from cookies(), not a proxy route. Step 5: directly invoke both proxy routes' GET() (T-10/T-12) with the same cookie present; assert each attaches the identical Authorization: Bearer header on its own server-to-server call to FastAPI. Step 6: render ProgramDetailView (RTL) with programDetailApi.client (F-14) mocked to hit those same proxy behaviors; assert the browser-visible request never carries an Authorization header or a token value anywhere, and that next/headers is not imported by ProgramDetailView.tsx or programDetailApi.client.ts (grep-assert). Confirms 'sourced via the Route Handler proxy, not a direct cookies() read' (TC-02 expected_results) literally.
